signal_grades.note: Each signal is tested on its own: when it appeared, did SPCX move the way it predicts 5 trading days later (daily) or 7 hours later (hourly)? "Helpful" means right at least 58% of the time with a positive average move, "Misleading" means wrong more often than right, and "Too few" means under 10 examples so far.

today_paragraph: SPCX closed at $138.17, down 3.7% today. The daily trend is down: price is below its 20-day average, which is below the 50-day. The overall score is leaning bearish (-30), with one caution on the daily chart: MACD positive. Options look fairly priced, assuming 58% yearly volatility versus 64% the stock has actually shown. The options market expects a move of about ±12% by Dec 11.
